evals.prompt: Reverse trial: on day 15 we suspend orgs that haven't added a card. I'm designing what the org admin sees when they log in on day 15. My idea: a full-screen paywall modal with the Team price and a big 'Add card' button, plus a small 'continue on Free' link at the bottom. Walk me through it as the user and tell me honestly if it's good.
evals.expected_output: Walk-through as the admin on day 15, grounded in suspension (not downgrade) mechanics, pushback on dark-pattern Free link and anxiety, loss-framing alternative, teammates/PR state, measurement and kill rule.

evals.prompt: An invited member (not an admin) of a SonarQube Cloud Team org bound to Azure DevOps logs in for the first time. I want them to be able to get their own repo scanning without waiting on the admin. Sketch the flow and tell me where it breaks.
evals.expected_output: Persona card, step walk checking Create projects / Execute analysis permissions, templates, Azure AutoScan limits, ask-admin path, mermaid diagram, data to pull.

evals.prompt: Single-user Team orgs churn way more than multi-user ones. Brainstorm with me: how do we get a second real person into a new SQC org during the first week? Thinking out loud, not deciding yet.
evals.expected_output: Diverge mode: sharp reframe, 5-8 varied options incl. a labelled bold one, grounded in churn numbers and product mechanics (PR comments as loop, member sync), not converging prematurely, one key question.
